name: vrana/adminer
description: Database management in a single PHP file.

scripts.submodules: @php -r "passthru('git submodule update --init --recursive'); if (getenv('COMPOSER_DEV_MODE') !== '0') { passthru('npm install --no-save --prefix . eslint @eslint/js globals @playwright/test'); }"

scripts-descriptions.submodules: Initializes the git submodules and installs the npm packages
scripts-descriptions.check: Checks the code by phpcs, phpstan and eslint
scripts-descriptions.test: Runs the unit tests in tests/unit/
scripts-descriptions.compat: Compiles the single files and checks them for APIs missing in the oldest supported PHP
scripts-descriptions.e2e: Runs the end-to-end tests by Playwright (see tests/README.md)
scripts-descriptions.compile: Compiles Adminer with all drivers and languages into adminer.php
scripts-descriptions.clean: Removes the compiled adminer*.php and editor*.php
